description: Fix file encoding issue in Python script at /home/ga/workspace/encoding_project/analyze_data.py. The file was created on Windows with Windows-1252 encoding and contains French accented characters that appear garbled when opened with UTF-8. To fix: (1) Open the file in VSCode, (2) Click the encoding indicator in status bar (bottom-right, shows 'UTF-8'), (3) Select 'Reopen with Encoding', (4) Choose 'Western (Windows 1252)' or 'Western (ISO 8859-1)', (5) Verify French text is now readable, (6) Click encoding indicator again, (7) Select 'Save with Encoding', (8) Choose 'UTF-8', (9) Save file with Ctrl+S. The file should contain correctly displayed French words like 'données', 'été', 'météo', 'français', 'températures', etc.
